File No.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
S. 2. Station,
REPORT
Date January 31, 19 31.
Subject (in full) Miss A.A. Laschick Mitzick.
Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by Whouncan 155J.
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter of January
23, 1931 from H.B.M. Consulate General re Miss A.A. Laschick
Mitzick, inquiries show that she is a native of Odessa, Hersen
Prov., South Russia. In 1914 she left with her parents for
Vladivostok where her father was employed with the Russian
Mercantile Fleet. In 1920 the family left for Harbin where
her father was employed with the C.E.R. as a mechanic. In
1925 Miss Laschick Mitzick left for Peking where for a few
months she worked in a cabaret and then proceeded to Hankow.
In Hankow she cohabited for about three years with a Mr.
Baranoff, Russian jew. In 1929 while she was employed in a
cabaret in Hankow she met Mr. S.L. Crews, an employee at the
Chinese Maritime Customs, and in the autumn of 1930 they arrived
together in Shanghai. She has resided since at 606 Avenue Joffre.
She is unemployed and is supported by S.L. Crews.
There is nothing in Municipal Police records to
her detriment and she is not known to be connected with any
political movement.
G. Tcheremshansky
D. S.
D. C. (C. & S. Branches)
Reg. Letter please in accordance
with attached draft.
J.K.
31/1/31.

档案编号
上海公共租界工部局警务处。
S. 2. 巡捕房，
报告
日期 1931年1月31日。
主题（全称） A.A. Laschick Mitzick 小姐。
制作人 D.S. Tcheremshansky。转呈人 Whouncan 155J。
先生：

关于附上的英国驻上海总领事馆1931年1月23日有关 A.A. Laschick
Mitzick 小姐的信件，经查询显示，她系南俄罗斯赫尔松省敖德萨人。1914年，她随父母前往
符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴），其父受雇于俄罗斯商船队。1920年，全家前往哈尔滨，其
父受雇于中东铁路公司担任机械师。1925年，Laschick Mitzick 小姐前往北平，在那里
她在一家歌舞厅工作了几个月，随后前往汉口。
在汉口，她与一位名叫
Baranoff 的俄罗斯犹太人同居约三年。1929年，当她在汉口的一家歌舞厅工作时，她结识了
中国海关职员 S.L. Crews 先生，两人于1930年秋季一同抵达上海。此后她一直居住在霞飞路606号。
她目前无业，由 S.L. Crews 供养。
工部局警务处档案中没有任何不利于她的记录，且据知她与任何
政治运动均无关联。
G. Tcheremshansky
侦探警长
副督察长（刑事与特务处）
请按附件草稿拟写回信。
J.K.
1931年1月31日。

PASSPORT & REGISTRATION OFFICE
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL
& S. D. R.C.
P.O. BOX 259.
SHANGHAI.
S. R. D. 1954.
24 - 1 - 31.
23rd January, 1931.

Sir,

I beg to inform you that I have received
an application from Miss A.A. Laschick-Mitsick,
a non-Soviet Russian residing at 606, Avenue
Joffre, for a visa to enable her to proceed to
the United Kingdom for the purpose of marriage
with Mr. S.L. Grews, a British subject employed
with the Chinese Maritime Customs, who is at
present on leave in England.

Before telegraphing to London I should be
obliged if you could inform me whether there
is anything known against her.

I am,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

英国驻上海总领事馆
& S. D. R.C.
邮政信箱 259.
上海。
S. R. D. 1954.
24 - 1 - 31.
1931年1月23日。

先生：

谨通知阁下，我已收到居住在霞飞路606号的
非苏维埃俄罗斯籍人士 A.A. Laschick-Mitsick 小姐的申请，
申请签证以便前往联合王国，目的是与
中国海关任职的英籍人士 S.L. Grews 先生结婚，该先生目前
正在英国休假。

在向伦敦发电报之前，如蒙告知是否掌握任何
不利于她的情况，我将不胜感激。

此致，
敬礼

警务处处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。
